candidate.summary: Safe to upgrade. No source archive is published for HaierProtocol 0.9.31 in the Arduino Library Manager, so its headers could not be read. Drift read the release notes ([0.9.32 release notes](https://github.com/paveldn/HaierProtocol/releases/tag/0.9.32)) for HaierProtocol 0.9.32 and found nothing in it that announces a breaking change. That is weaker than a clean API comparison: it means nothing was flagged, not that nothing broke. OSV has no advisory coverage for arduino packages, so this upgrade's effect on known vulnerabilities could not be looked up.
